description: MMS gate: run the inline esm-spec 6.6 tests of problems/latlon_diffusion_meridional_zero_grad.esm (model MeridionalDiffusion, test mms_steady_polar_cap_diffusion) at the problem's default resolution (NLAT=91, NLON edge-bound to 8) through each binding's official simulation pathway. The assertions and their tolerances live in the problem file itself; this manifest only routes the runners.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

python._doc: Pinned so Python temporal truncation is negligible against the spatial goldens: LSODA at 1e-12/1e-14 handles the stiff diffusion sweep and agrees with the Julia Tsit5 reference to well under the error_vs_golden tolerance on every resolution, where a loose explicit RK method would leave a temporal residue comparable to the spatial error.
